messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-2026-4123 - model-catalog service - config mismatch detected (catalog revision vs tokenizer). Auto-scaling fallback triggered and some requests routed to fallback model variant.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Alert: model-catalog - TokenizerMismatch - P2. Triggered by runtime anomaly detector. Link: https://pd.example/INC-2026-4123 :rotating_light:

Marta (oncall): acked. I'm on it — initiating triage.

Liam (eng-runtime): logs show a surge of tokenization errors starting at ~2432099800. Samples: `ERROR tokenization: unknown_token_id=0, model=redwood-3b-q8`, followed by `500 internal` on inference path. Rate ~120 req/min for that variant.

Marta (oncall): any recent catalog promotions?

Liam (eng-runtime): yes, a catalog promotion went live ~2432099600. New revision `catalog@rev-2026-03-21-bc9` set default tokenizer to `tokenizer-v2` while model variant expects `tokenizer-v1`. Bad default.

Sanjay (prod-sre): ok. Impact: some customers seeing garbled responses and increased 500s. I'm preparing a rollback of the promotion.

Aisha (customer-ops): we've got 3 active support tickets (CS-1121, CS-1122, CS-1124). Customers report truncated outputs and occasional nondeterministic tokens. Noting enterprise customer "DataSync" is affected; I can notify them after rollback.

Marta (oncall): plan: 1) pin traffic away from affected variant, 2) rollback catalog promotion to previous rev, 3) run synthetic validation, 4) notify customers + ops. Who can execute rollback now?

Liam (eng-runtime): I'll run rollback. Rolling back to `catalog@rev-2026-03-20-a8f`. Command (will run):
```
# rollback catalog promotion
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/catalog/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"target_rev":"rev-2026-03-20-a8f","reason":"tokenizer mismatch causing 5xx"}'
```

incident-bot: Action initiated: catalog.rollback by Liam (eng-runtime) — request_id=rr-9c3f.

Marta (oncall): pinning routing so no traffic goes to `variant-b` until we validate.

Sanjay (prod-sre): I've started a gradual rollback monitor and synthetic probes against chat/generate endpoints. Early results: error rate dropping from 0.9% -> 0.1% for affected surfaces after rollback.

Devon (product): any data integrity concerns? PII leakage?

Liam (eng-runtime): no evidence of exfiltration. This is a tokenizer mismatch that mangles token boundaries; it leads to bad outputs and occasional runtime errors, not data leakage. We'll include this in postmortem.

Aisha (customer-ops): I'll send an interim status to DataSync and the 3 impacted customers: "We've identified a config mismatch in a recent catalog promotion. We rolled back to the previous catalog revision; our teams are monitoring. We'll follow up with an RCA and timeline for fixes."

Marta (oncall): escalation check — PagerDuty auto-escalated at +5m but I acknowledged quickly, canceling further escalation. Noting for the log.

Sanjay (prod-sre): monitoring 10m window now. Also running a targeted tokenization test suite across all promoted variants to catch any other mismatches.

Liam (eng-runtime): short-term fix: add a catalog validation gate for tokenizer/model compatibility before promotion. I'll open a PR after incident.

Marta (oncall): handing off to Sanjay for post-rollback watch and logs collection. Sanjay, can you own the follow-up diagnostics and coordinate the RCA timeline?

Sanjay (prod-sre): I got it. I'll collect logs, surface the exact promotion diff, and schedule a 1hr RCA in #postmortems. Tentative ETA for RCA doc: 24 hours.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4123 update: rollback completed, P2 sustained status -> monitoring.

Marta (oncall): Thanks everyone. Final notes: customers notified by Aisha, rollback complete by Liam, monitoring owned by Sanjay. Will convene for RCA tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Devon (product): please add a follow-up action to add an automated integration test that validates tokenizer_id compatibility in the promotion pipeline.

Sanjay (prod-sre): added to the RCA action list.

Marta (oncall): closing thread here, will re-open if anything regresses.
